meta.name: ulw-loop
meta.description: Goal-like loop that uses ultrawork mode to decompose work into systematic, evidence-bound steps.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将复杂工作分解为循证步骤
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望把模糊目标拆解成可执行、有依据的步骤
copy.tagline_en: Break down complex work into evidence-based steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to decompose vague goals into actionable, evidence-backed steps

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把你的大任务拆成许多带证据的细步骤，每步都记录到检查清单并追踪进度；它会遵循停止规则，需要时把代码修改、测试等交给专门助手，并验证每个步骤的可观察结果。
howto.when: 当你说出“ulw-loop”等关键词，或要求做证据导向、有检查点的长时交付时触发。

say.text: 用 ulw-loop 把任务拆成带证据的小步骤，逐步执行。
say.note: Claude 会读取工作流并开始拆解、追踪。

say.text: 启动 ulw 模式，目标：完成 API 重构，每步记录验证结果。
say.note: 会按清单推进并记录每条证据。

say.text: 用 ulw 检查当前计划，标出缺少证据的步骤。
say.note: 它查看状态并报告缺口。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude breaks the user's goal into small evidence-backed steps, tracks them on a live checklist, follows stop rules, and verifies each step with observable evidence, delegating code edits and tests when needed.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions 'ulw-loop' or similar keywords, or asks for evidence-led work or checkpointed long-running delivery.

say_en.text: Use ulw-loop to break the task into evidence-backed steps and execute them.
say_en.note: Claude reads the workflow and starts tracking.

say_en.text: Start ulw mode with this goal: finish API refactor, recording verifiable results each step.
say_en.note: It proceeds checklist-style and logs evidence.

say_en.text: Use ulw to review progress and flag steps missing evidence.
say_en.note: It checks state and reports gaps.
